name: Glance
what: A Chrome extension (also runs in Quo) that shows unread mail from all your Gmail accounts in one calm list, in a toolbar popup or side panel. For people juggling several inboxes who want to triage fast, keyboard-first.
tagline: All your Gmail inboxes, one calm glance away.
ideas: a glance: an eye, a look, a glint
many into one: several inboxes merging into one list
calm / inbox zero: settled, empty, a horizon
references: none given: pulled from Are.na (default logo channels plus a minimal monochrome set)
lives: browser toolbar icon at 16 and 32 px
icon_shape: black rounded tile with the mark knocked out in white
